data.name: Aging Touch
data.description: Your touch ages living creatures and objects. As a melee touch attack, you can deal %1 points of Strength damage to living creatures. Against objects or constructs, you can deal %2d6 points of damage. If used against an object in another creature's possession, treat this attack as a sunder combat maneuver. You can use this ability %3/day.|AgingTouchStrDamage|AgingTouchDamageDice|AgingTouchTimes
